mechanism_description: TiCl4 undergoes rapid, highly exothermic hydrolysis in water, releasing HCl and lowering the solution pH in situ, which controls the nucleation/growth kinetics and phase (anatase vs rutile) of the resulting TiO2 and can act as a peptizing agent for colloidal sol formation.
search_query: TiCl4 hydrolysis HCl release pH control TiO2 anatase rutile phase sol-gel
